description: List all available pre-reasoned market briefings with tier requirements. Returns 33 LIVE briefings across Free (6), Basic (14), and Pro (13) tiers. The company briefing (equities.company) is one listed company per call, for the US on Basic and above, for Japan on Pro and above, for Korea on Pro and above, and for India on Pro and above (133 Indian company briefings counted on 2026-10-07). Covers Bitcoin, macro, FX, and cross-asset financial data categories. No authentication required.

tier.description: Filter briefings by subscription tier (free, basic, or pro). Returns all tiers if omitted.
